headline: LAD @ ARI matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is LAD 4.37 at ARI 4.21, with a projected total of 8.58. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward ARI: LAD moved +0.16 runs while ARI moved +1.26, changing the projected margin by -1.10 runs. The projected total climbed +1.42, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Ryne Nelson has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Andy Pages, Freddie Freeman, Ketel Marte, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jose Fernandez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
